text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan's hooves were in the worst 
possible condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With even the thought of skipping the 
Satsuki Sho crossing her mind, Tosen 
Jordan tearfully pleaded with her Trainer 
that she absolutely wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...Prepared to retire if unable to run. 
Regardless of what transpires after the 
Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tosen Jordan's determination, her 
Trainer chooses a path that won't give up 
on the Satsuki Sho while continuing 
treatment on her hooves.
